allowed: active-node, gateway-to-node grant, and key-epoch lookup

fail-closed regular-file, no-symlink, private-permission, basename-only, and exact-key-length checks

unit, corruption, permission, path-escape, inactive-node, unauthorized-gateway, unknown-epoch, and no-mutation tests

ESP-NOW firmware or ESPHome product changes

storage_contract.authorization_database: SQLite metadata only; runtime opens mode=ro and never creates or mutates it
storage_contract.key_storage: one 0700 private directory containing basename-only 0600 regular non-symlink raw 32-byte key files

inactive node, unauthorized gateway-node pair, unknown or disabled key epoch fail closed
missing, malformed, world/group-accessible, symlinked, escaping, or wrong-size key material fails closed
authorization metadata database is existing, private, schema-valid, integrity-valid, and read-only
audit verifies all enabled metadata/key references without returning secrets or mutating state
CLI preflight works without a registration database and does not create missing authorization state
relay ingress and replay-registry regression tests remain green
